meta.pageTitleEn: How to Apply for a Chinese Visa | Requirements & Process 2026
meta.pageTitleZh: 中国签证申请完整指南｜材料、流程、常见问题 2026
meta.pageDescEn: Complete guide to apply for Chinese tourist / business visa. Documents, application steps, processing time, FAQs for foreign citizens who are not eligible for China visa-free entry.
meta.pageDescZh: 不享受中国免签政策外籍人士办理中国旅游、商务签证完整指南，申请材料、办理流程、时效、常见问题。
meta.lastUpdateHintEn: For reference only, subject to consulate official announcements
meta.lastUpdateHintZh: 仅供参考，以使领馆官方公告为准

intro.para1En: If your nationality is NOT covered by unilateral visa-free, mutual visa exemption or 240-hour transit visa-free schemes, you must obtain a proper Chinese visa before travelling to mainland China. This guide summarizes official requirements published by the National Immigration Administration and Chinese overseas diplomatic missions.
intro.para1Zh: 如果您的国籍不属于单方面免签、互免签证、240小时过境免签范围，前往中国大陆出行前必须提前办妥中国签证。本指南汇总国家移民管理局及中国驻外使领馆公开官方要求。
intro.para2En: Important note: This website serves as informational reference only. Final rules, forms and decisions belong to Chinese embassies, consulates-general and visa service centres.
intro.para2Zh: 重要提示：本站仅作资讯参考；最终申请要求、表格、审批结果以中国驻外大使馆、总领事馆及签证申请中心为准。

visaTypesTitleEn: Common Visa Types for Foreign Visitors
visaTypesTitleZh: 外籍访客常用签证类型

visaTypes.descEn: For sightseeing, travel, family visiting purposes.
visaTypes.descZh: 用于观光旅游、探亲访问。

visaTypes.descEn: For commercial-trade activities, business meetings and negotiations.
visaTypes.descZh: 从事商贸活动、商务会谈洽谈。

visaTypes.descEn: For paid employment in China; requires pre-approval.
visaTypes.descZh: 来华务工就业，需要提前取得就业许可。

docList.descEn: Original passport with at least 6-month remaining validity and ≥2 blank visa pages.
docList.descZh: 护照原件，有效期大于6个月，至少2页空白签证页。

docList.descEn: Completed online application form, recent passport-style photograph.
docList.descZh: 在线填写完整签证申请表，近期证件照片。

docList.descEn: Flight booking records, planned travel schedule in China.
docList.descZh: 往返机票预订单、在华行程计划表。

docList.descEn: Invitation letter, business letter, family relation proof or admission notice depending on visa type.
docList.descZh: 邀请函、商务公函、亲属关系证明或录取通知书，根据签证类型提供。

processSteps.descEn: Gather passport, photos and supporting papers according to visa type.
processSteps.descZh: 按签证类型准备护照、照片以及各类证明材料。

processSteps.descEn: Complete official Chinese visa application form online.
processSteps.descZh: 在线填写中国签证官方申请表。

processSteps.descEn: Submit at Chinese Embassy / Consulate-General or authorized Visa Application Service Center.
processSteps.descZh: 向中国驻外使领馆或授权签证申请中心递交申请。

processSteps.descEn: Pay visa fee, wait for processing. Normal processing time varies by location.
processSteps.descZh: 缴纳签证费用，等待审核，普通办理时效各地使领馆存在差异。

processSteps.descEn: Collect your passport; check visa entries, duration of stay for correctness.
processSteps.descZh: 取回护照，核对签证入境次数、停留期限信息。

processingNoteEn: Processing Time Reminder: Standard service usually takes 4-7 working days. Express or urgent service may be available subject to consulate availability.
processingNoteZh: 办理时效提醒：普通受理一般4-7个工作日；加急服务视使领馆业务情况提供。

visaFaqs.qEn: Can I apply for Chinese visa on-arrival?
visaFaqs.qZh: 我可以抵达中国口岸再申请签证吗？
visaFaqs.aEn: Ordinary foreign visitors cannot obtain tourist/business visa upon arrival. You must apply overseas before departure.
visaFaqs.aZh: 普通外籍旅客不能口岸落地办理旅游商务签证，必须出境前在海外申请。

visaFaqs.qEn: What should I do if my visa application gets rejected?
visaFaqs.aEn: Embassies-consulates do not disclose detailed rejection reasons. You may re-apply after improving supporting documentation.
visaFaqs.aZh: 使领馆一般不披露具体拒签理由；完善材料后可以重新递交。

visaFaqs.qEn: Does holding a visa guarantee entry into China?
visaFaqs.qZh: 拿到签证就一定可以入境中国吗？
visaFaqs.aEn: A Chinese visa only permits you to apply for entry. Final admission decision is made by China border inspection authorities at port of arrival.
visaFaqs.aZh: 签证仅代表申请入境资格；最终是否允许入境由中国口岸边检机关判定。

visaFaqs.qEn: Can I extend my Chinese visa after entering mainland China?
visaFaqs.qZh: 入境中国后可以在境内延期签证吗？
visaFaqs.aEn: Certain visa categories can apply for extension at local Exit-Entry Administration before expiry. Extension approval is not guaranteed.
visaFaqs.aZh: 部分签证类型可在到期前于出入境管理局申请延期，延期审批不一定通过。
